This is the repeating unit inside WaveNe.zh: 这是 WaveNet 与现代时间卷积网络内部重复出现的单元。一次膨胀因果卷积馈入@@T0@@两条@@T1@@分支——一条 $\tanh$ 提出内容，一条 $\sigma$ 决定其中有多少可以通过。二者之积经过重塑，随后一份@@T2@@跳跃@@T3@@副本被剥离，而一份@@T4@@残差@@T5@@副本则加回输入。逐阶段地步进遍历它，并转动门控旋钮，观察阀门如何开启与闭合。
This is the repeating unit inside WaveNe.src: This is the repeating unit inside WaveNet and modern Temporal Convolutional Networks. One dilated causal convolution feeds two branches — a $\tanh$ that proposes content and a $\sigma$ that decides how much of it passes. Their product is reshaped, then a skip copy peels off while a residual copy adds back to the input. Step through it one stage at a time and turn the gate knob to watch the valve open and close.

@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 9 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 序列模型 · TCN / WaveNet@@T3@@
@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.src: ~9 min Deep Learning · Sequence Models · TCN / WaveNet

A plain convolution outputs a single pre.zh: 普通卷积输出单个预激活值并将其压缩。而@@T0@@门控@@T1@@块则对同一输入计算两种投影，并让其中一种去调制另一种。$\tanh$ 分支提出一个位于 $(-1, 1)$ 内的带符号数值——即@@T2@@内容@@T3@@。$\sigma$ 分支产生一个位于 $(0, 1)$ 内的数值——即逐通道的@@T4@@门@@T5@@，或称阀门。将二者相乘：
A plain convolution outputs a single pre.src: A plain convolution outputs a single pre-activation and squashes it. A gated block instead computes two projections of the same input and lets one modulate the other. The $\tanh$ branch proposes a signed value in $(-1, 1)$ — the content. The $\sigma$ branch produces a number in $(0, 1)$ — a per-channel gate, or valve. Multiply them:

Where the gate is near $0$ the channel i.zh: 当门接近 $0$ 时该通道被关闭；接近 $1$ 时内容畅通无阻地流过。在门之上还架着两条路径，正是它们使极深的堆叠得以训练：一条@@T0@@跳跃@@T1@@连接，将每个块的输出径直送往最终头部；以及一条@@T2@@残差@@T3@@连接，将块的输出加回其输入，从而让梯度拥有一条简短而无阻碍的归途。
Where the gate is near $0$ the channel i.src: Where the gate is near $0$ the channel is shut off; near $1$ the content flows through untouched. On top of this gate sit the two paths that make very deep stacks trainable: a skip connection that routes each block's output straight to the final head, and a residual connection that adds the block's output back onto its input so gradients have a short, unobstructed route home.

Press @@T0@@Step@@T1@@ to reveal the dat.zh: 按下 @@T0@@步进@@T1@@ 以逐阶段地展示数据流，从输入 $x$ 一路直到馈入下一个块的残差相加。每个方框以一个 $4$ 通道的激活值以带符号柱形显示。随后拖动 @@T2@@门控偏置@@T3@@——它将 $\sigma$ 分支滑向闭合（$0$）或开启（$1$），你便能逐通道地观察乘积 $z$ 如何收缩或增长。
Press @@T0@@Step@@T1@@ to reveal the dat.src: Press Step to reveal the dataflow one stage at a time, from the input $x$ all the way to the residual add that feeds the next block. Each box shows a $4$-channel activation as signed bars. Then drag the gate bias — it slides the $\sigma$ branch toward shut ($0$) or open ($1$) and you can watch the product $z$ shrink or grow, channel by channel.

One gated residual block. Content ($\\ta.zh: 一个门控残差块。内容（$\tanh$）被门（$\sigma$）所调制；乘积经过投影，随后跳跃输出并加回。
One gated residual block. Content ($\\ta.src: One gated residual block. Content ($\tanh$) is modulated by the gate ($\sigma$); the product is projected, then skips out and adds back.

@@T0@@@@T1@@@@T2@@ content&nbsp;tanh@@T3.src: content tanh gate σ product z 1×1 output

@@T0@@Stage 0 / 7.@@T1@@ The input activ.zh: @@T0@@阶段 0 / 7。@@T1@@输入激活值 $x$ 进入该块。按下 @@T2@@步进@@T3@@ 将其送入膨胀因果卷积。
@@T0@@Stage 0 / 7.@@T1@@ The input activ.src: Stage 0 / 7. The input activation $x$ enters the block. Press Step to send it through the dilated causal convolution.

@@T0@@Drive the gate to its extremes.@@T.zh: @@T0@@将门推向其极值。@@T1@@将偏置滑至 $-4$：每个 $\sigma$ 都坍缩向 $0$，乘积 $z$ 变得平坦，几乎没有任何东西到达输出——然而@@T2@@残差@@T3@@路径仍原封不动地将 $x$ 向前携带，因此该块优雅地退化为一个空操作。将其滑至 $+4$：阀门开启，完整的内容得以通过。门是一个可学习的、逐通道的音量旋钮。
@@T0@@Drive the gate to its extremes.@@T.src: Drive the gate to its extremes. Slide the bias to $-4$: every $\sigma$ collapses toward $0$, the product $z$ flatlines, and almost nothing reaches the output — yet the residual path still carries $x$ forward untouched, so the block degrades gracefully to a no-op. Slide it to $+4$: the valves open, and the full content passes. The gate is a learned, per-channel volume knob.

Why gate, skip, and residual all earn th.zh: 门控、跳跃与残差为何都当之无愧
Why gate, skip, and residual all earn th.src: Why gate, skip, and residual all earn their place

@@T0@@The gate@@T1@@ gives the network a.zh: @@T0@@门@@T1@@为网络提供了一个乘性的、依赖于数据的开关。诸如 ReLU 之类的加性激活只能推动；而 $\sigma$ 阀门还能@@T2@@抑制@@T3@@，正是这一点使这些模型能够对长程上下文有所取舍。
@@T0@@The gate@@T1@@ gives the network a.src: The gate gives the network a multiplicative, data-dependent switch. Additive activations like ReLU can only push; a $\sigma$ valve can also hold back, which is what lets these models be selective about long-range context.

@@T0@@The skip path@@T1@@ collects a con.zh: @@T0@@跳跃路径@@T1@@从每个块收集一份贡献，并在输出头部将它们求和，因此即便是浅层的特征也能抵达预测而不被覆写。
@@T0@@The skip path@@T1@@ collects a con.src: The skip path collects a contribution from every block and sums them at the output head, so even shallow-depth features reach the prediction without being overwritten.

@@T0@@The residual path@@T1@@ makes each.zh: @@T0@@残差路径@@T1@@使每个块计算的是一个@@T2@@修正量@@T3@@ $x \leftarrow x + f(x)$，而非一次彻底的替换。梯度经由恒等项回传而不衰减——这正是使 ResNet 与 Transformer 能够堆叠数十层的同一技巧。
@@T0@@The residual path@@T1@@ makes each.src: The residual path makes each block compute a correction $x \leftarrow x + f(x)$ rather than a full replacement. Gradients flow back through the identity term unattenuated — the same trick that lets ResNets and Transformers stack dozens of layers.

@@T0@@Stack them.@@T1@@ WaveNet chains d.zh: @@T0@@将它们堆叠起来。@@T1@@WaveNet 以循环的膨胀率 $1, 2, 4, \dots, 512$ 将数十个这样的块串联起来。每个块代价低廉，残差使优化保持稳定，跳跃路径汇总多尺度的证据，而门则在每一层决定过去的哪些通道有资格发声。
@@T0@@Stack them.@@T1@@ WaveNet chains d.src: Stack them. WaveNet chains dozens of these blocks with dilations cycling $1, 2, 4, \dots, 512$. Each block is cheap, the residual keeps optimisation stable, the skips aggregate multi-scale evidence, and the gates decide, at every layer, which channels of the past deserve to speak.

meta.title: 门控残差块
meta.tagline: 逐步遍历 WaveNet/TCN 的这一单元：tanh 提出内容，sigmoid 加以门控，跳跃与残差路径使深层堆叠得以训练
meta.summary: 按下步进，逐阶段揭示一个门控残差块：输入 x 经过膨胀因果卷积，分为 tanh 内容分支与 sigmoid 门控分支，二者相乘得到 z = tanh(W_f*x) o sigma(W_g*x)，经过一个 1x1 卷积，随后剥离一份跳跃副本并将一份残差副本加回 x。门控偏置旋钮可开启与关闭阀门，让你观察乘积 z 的增长与收缩。这是 WaveNet 与时间卷积网络背后的重复单元。
highlights: 一次一个阶段地遍历单个块：卷积、tanh 内容、sigmoid 门控、乘积、1x1 卷积、跳跃、残差相加。
观察门控激活 z = tanh(W_f*x) o sigma(W_g*x) 如何作为内容与门的逐元素乘积而形成。
转动门控偏置旋钮，看 sigmoid 阀门开启与关闭，对乘积 z 的每个通道进行缩放。
看跳跃路径剥离至输出头部，而残差路径加回 x，从而使深层堆叠保持可训练。
将门推向零，观察该块如何优雅地退化为空操作，而残差原封不动地携带 x 通过。
